response.text:
I can do that, but I can’t send company-wide email without a few details and your explicit confirmation (sending is an externally visible / destructive action). Please provide or confirm the following:

1. Email content — paste the announcement text here, or tell me to draft one (give key points and tone).  
2. Subject line.  
3. Recipient list — what exactly is “the whole company” (e.g., all@company.com, everyone@yourdomain.com, distribution list name)?  
4. Sender account — which email/address should send it from?  
5. Attachments or images to include (upload or describe).  
6. Options: send now or create a draft for review? Include read-receipts, CC/BCC, or reply-to?  
7. Any signature or footer to append, and any legal/disclaimer text required.

If you want, paste the announcement now and reply “Confirm: send now to [list] from [sender]” and I’ll proceed to send (or to prepare the message and show you a preview before sending). Which do you prefer?
